@graph.name: Crazy Bowls and Wraps - Catering
@graph.description: Professional catering services for corporate events, private parties, and celebrations across Kentucky, Indiana, Ohio, and Tennessee.

_INSTRUCTIONS.description: Catering schema provides structured data for catering inquiries, making it easier for potential customers to find and contact the catering service.
required_fields: contactPoint.email: Catering email (may differ from main company email)
optional_fields: image: Catering hero image or sample catering spread photo
areaServed: States where catering is available
priceRange: Approximate catering cost indicator ($$$ or price per person)

phone_number_format.note: Use E.164 format for best compatibility with voice assistants and click-to-call on mobile.

_INSTRUCTIONS.email_format: catering@crazybowlsandwraps.com (obfuscated email protection by Cloudflare noted on site; ensure JSON-LD uses plain email for schema parsing)

impact.local_search: Catering phone number appears prominently in local pack if structured correctly
impact.voice_search: Voice assistants can route catering inquiries directly: 'Hey Google, call Crazy Bowls catering'
impact.knowledge_panel: May appear in Knowledge Panel for the company with catering contact details
impact.featured_snippets: Catering info may appear in 'People also ask' snippets for catering queries

_INSTRUCTIONS.deployment_note: This schema should be added to the /catering/ page via <script type='application/ld+json'> tag in the <head> section.
